description: Queued deferred commands carry uninitialised stack bytes: the 0x30-byte record header copies [rsp+0x40..0x4F] whose bytes 0xC..0xF ([rsp+0x4C]) are never written, and 142DEDDA0 writes only the low 4 bytes of the list entry field at +8, leaving +0xC..+0xF as they were
evidence: disassembly 142DFEDCD..142DFEE26 and 142DEDDE2; measured: loading mp_t_gun_course in the emulator leaves 1 in those bytes where the translated loaders leave 0 (tests/assets/loaders_check.py skips exactly them). No reader of the values found
